Where they see a longship, he sees a displacement curve waiting to be optimized. Where they see a storm, he sees wind energy waiting to be harnessed.
They say his methods are madness. Soon, they will realize that while they are playing at war, he is engineering an empire.

remarry-no-way:
Married for four years, there was no love in the life of Su Ran and Song Ting Yu. They were forced to marry because of Su Ran’s pregnancy. Ting Yu thought Su Ran was a foxy woman that tricked him with a purpose to enter the Song household, that’s why after the night after they both said the wedding vow, he immediately went overseas to be with his love and never came back even once​ to see his son.
Four years later, Song Wei Xi, the son of Su Ran and Song Ting Yu, was diagnosed with a rare illness. Madame Song, Ting Yu’s grandmother, knew this situation was urgent and asked Song Ting Yu to come home to help with this situation. Song Ting Yu couldn’t help but come back home, he came back to face his forgotten wife and child. Su Ran promised Ting Yu that she will sign the divorce paper if he agreed​ to help. Will Song Ting Yu agree with this proposal? Will he still leave after the recovery of Song We Xi or will he stay? Will love start to grow in their family?
rumor-has-it-im-dating-the-football-capt:
One blurry photo. That's all it took to ruin Audrey Ellis's entire second year.
After surviving the most humiliating breakup on campus, all she wanted was to become invisible. No rumors, no whispers, no more being that girl.
Then Westbridge University's anonymous gossip page decided she was secretly dating Mason Calloway, the football team's captain and the biggest heartbreaker on campus, and invisible stopped being an option.
Overnight she goes from the clingy ex to the mystery girlfriend everyone's obsessed with. Audrey wants the rumor gone by morning. Mason, on the other hand, thinks it's the funniest thing that's happened to him all semester, and he has zero interest in helping her kill it.
Fake headlines. Chaotic teammates who won't stop meddling. A rumor that refuses to die no matter how hard she tries to bury it. The more Audrey and Mason pretend, the harder it gets to remember what's fake and what isn't.
Turns out the girl determined to never fall for anyone and the guy who's never taken a relationship seriously might be building the one thing neither of them saw coming.
soul-land-bibi-dong-is-my-martial-soul:
Bibi Dong, once the powerful Supreme Pontiff, never expected to be reborn—especially not as someone else's martial spirit. In this new life, she finds herself bound to a young soul master with great potential but little knowledge of the powerful spirit within him.
As Bibi Dong guides her host, she must confront her past mistakes and figure out why she was given this second chance. Is it to correct her past, or is there something more at play?
space-odyssey-from-abandoned-mining-spac:
Chen Ming has just transmigrated and awoken from an abandoned mining space station.
With only a damaged civilian mining spaceship in his possession, he knows that his top priority is to find a way to survive.
As a string of text pops up in his mind, he knows that this time, luck is on his side.
[22mm Machine Gun]
[Type: Small Kinetic Energy Weapon]
[Ammo Load: 231/1000]
[Durability: 54%]
[Available Actions: Replace/Repair]
sss-rank-talent-super-upgrade-system:
Facing extinction, humanity seeks salvation in the Astral Verge, a dangerous dimension accessed via portals that threatened to wipe out the entire planet.
Few years later, aspiring recruit Daniel Vance enters the Verge for his final assessment, hoping to Awaken a Talent and secure his future. While others gain common abilities, Daniel secretly Awakens the mythical SSS-Grade Talent: [Soul Assimilation]. This allows him to absorb essence, enhancing gear, gaining stats and EXP from slain creatures, and crucially, absorbing attributes and skills from fallen Awakened.
Witnessing the swift death of the arrogant Jaxon Rex, Daniel makes a grim choice: he assimilates Jaxon, gaining his first skill, [Kinetic Pulse]. This sets his path: scavenging the aftermath of others’ battles. He enhances gear and, after achieving his first kill on an injured beast, waits patiently to assimilate two more fallen recruits, acquiring [Quick Step] and the invaluable passive [Aura Sense].
Starting as average, Daniel rapidly gains power in secret, enhanced gear, multiple skills, and boosted stats , far exceeding his peers while remaining outwardly unremarkable.…
supreme-man:
Ye Hao... the leader of a South African mercenary group, obtained a ring from outer space during his time as a mercenary.
Within the ring lies unprecedented high-tech advancements on Earth, awe-inspiring weapons, and a UFO capable of interstellar travel...
Various reasons led this young man, who served as a mercenary in South Africa, to return to the city, embarking on a path of life dedicated to protecting beautiful women.
the-cannon-fodder-turns-his-sister-into-:
After transmigrating into a fantasy game world, Ye Anping became an unknown cannon fodder with low qualifications who was destined to die tragically at the hands of a villain at the age of fifteen. So, he was a little desperate.
Fortunately, he was only four years old now, and there was a cannon fodder younger sister with excellent aptitude by his side.
Ten years later, the junior sister had grown up, becoming not only beautiful but also stronger. She caught the attention of the protagonist.
And then Ye Anping became fed up with the whole situation.
Ye Anping: “Junior sister, I am your senior brother, stay away from me!”
Junior sister: “Protagonist, I’m just an ordinary person, stay away from me!”
Protagonist : ” I am wholeheartedly devoted to you Lady…”
the-challenge-of-a-farmhouse-son-in-law:
The village girl who was close to death from illness was about to marry, and her suitor was a strong and hearty hunter.
Having time-traveled to a poor and backward mountain village, she had resigned herself to the lack of three square meals a day, but was her new body already halfway into the grave? What's more curious was that someone still wanted to marry her despite being on her deathbed?
Driven by curiosity, she went ahead with the marriage, eager to see who the unlucky sap was who'd lose his betrothal gifts and even the coffin money.
Cradled in his arms, her body was thin as a rake, and she really wanted to ask him, “Husband, does holding me hurt your hands?”
the-female-ceo-falls-in-love-with-me: Li Yan is an employee of a large company full of beauties and his wife is exactly the CEO. But their relationship has been kept secret. What stories would happen between them?
the-job-of-an-imperial-concubine:
To pass as an imperial concubine, one must be professional.
Actually, the profession of an imperial concubine is pretty good. The emperor will accompany you in eating and drinking, and even pay you for it. What’s not good about that?
the-king-of-beast-trainers:
A brand new masterpiece by the author of “Unscientific Beast Taming”!!!
The best fantasy novels in China in 2023！
The invasion of creatures from different time and space gave birth to the “Beast Master” profession, and the protagonist was selected by a mysterious “black card”, indicating that he has the qualification of a Beast Master and can contract to control pets to fight for himself!
“Who could become the undisputed King of Beast Trainers in the brand-new Beast Training Era?”
Royal Beast+Online Gaming+Spiritual Energy Recovery+Secret Realm
the-lust-system-hunt-beyond-worlds:
Caution
Taboo 18+
Banished by failure and despair, a virgin loser wakes in a new world with a forbidden power—the Lust System. To survive and claim a rare herb that could save him, he must seduce, corrupt, and conquer hearts across worlds. Pleasure is the key to power…and survival.
the-moon-goddess-chosen:
Humans and Werewolves have lived together in this world for nearly four hundred years… Since the appearance of the first two werewolves, royals, given this power by the moon goddess herself.
In a world where humans and werewolves live together in a tight and uncertain collaboration filled with mistrust and pretence, hunters exist to keep the peace while rogues exist to disrupt it.
Two children are born… destined to put a stop to all the bloodshed and suffering, but not everyone likes the idea of a world with peace between the werewolves and the humans…..
With the Moon goddess along with the Prometheus, the god of mankind only able to watch and provide assistance where possible without breaking divine laws, the question still stands. Will her Chosen Ones be able to accomplish the task at hand…..
The Rogue King strives to keep the two from ever uniting, forcing the them to lead lives that can never be described as normal, but can be called interesting…
the-undetectable-strongest-job-rule-brea:
By some ill fortune, Hikaru died in a traffic accident. He was in heaven standing in line, waiting to be judged, when he took an unexpected request to transfer his soul to a person in another world. He received an ability called Soul Board which he could use to allocate points to Skills to make himself more powerful.
But there was a catch…
「I want you to take revenge on someone for me within an hour. If you don’t, I’ll destroy your soul.」
To pull off the task assigned to him, he poured all his available points to the Stealth skill tree.
This is a story of a boy who specialized in Stealth. With his skill trees as weapons, he would demonstrate his unrivaled strength in another world.
transmigrated-as-the-mother-of-the-abuse:
[Short Story] [Food Writing] [Sweet Little Cake] One day Ding Sha got transmigrated into a book, with a baby of unknown parentage in her belly.
Upon closer look, the baby turned out to be the male lead from a previous angsty novel she read.
A poor little thing unloved by his parents.
So impoverished that her stomach rumbled, but armed with superb cooking skills, she transformed herself from Ding Sha into the boxed lunch beauty at the construction site.
Kung pao chicken, garlic baby bok choy, spicy pork belly, tossed noodles – she cooked up a storm.
Before the construction workers could feel the stirrings of spring in their hearts, the baby’s father suddenly appeared.
Jun, carrying a travel bag stuffed full of cash, squatted outside the door gazing longingly at Ding Sha’s slightly bulging belly.
“Wife…I’m back…”
A 1v1 sweet doting story without abuse, a light and fluffy little sweet cake, safe for consumption.
transmigration-in-an-online-game-as-the-:
[The world is explained in detail, with even some useless features written down.]
A man known as Joel lost an enormous amount of money on investments. He was about to win 400 million dollars in a game but failed. He went mad.
Then, a notification from the company rang on his phone with a proposal of 10 billion dollars if he completed a new version of the game, and that opened the way for a new playthrough and he was transmigrated into the game as Malvoid, the Rotten character.
[My vocabulary and grammar are not the best... you may find broken sentences and others]
trapped-in-a-marriage-i-never-wanted:
Victoria received a marriage certificate when she was about to be proposed to by her boyfriend. The marriage certificate showed that she had married a stranger two years ago. The stranger was a CEO who was known to be a perfectionist and arrogant named Matthias. What actually happened? Why couldn't she remember anything that happened two years ago due to an accident? What was on her mind now was that she really hated Matthias because all her dreams were destroyed in an instant and she was trapped in a marriage that she didn't want.
Meanwhile, Matthias deliberately sent the marriage certificate to Victoria so that his woman's engagement to another man would be canceled. Matthias didn't know how Victoria could suddenly leave him two years ago. When he investigated the case of his wife's sudden disappearance, he just found out that his wife disappeared because of an accident that was deliberately hidden by his wife's adoptive family and her family. Matthias suspected that Victoria's accident was the result of evil deeds carried out by both families.…
urban-god-level-youth:
A typical, frail senior high school student had acquired the SuperCivilization Technology System.
From academic dreg to academic prodigy, from the weak to the strong.
Basketball genius, top-level hacker, medical sage, business tycoon...
Empowering the nation through technology, elevating our great Huaxia!
utsuro-no-hako-to-zero-no-maria:
Utsuro no Hako to Zero no Maria, or The Empty Box and The Zeroth Maria, tells the sinister story of Kazuki Hoshino, who is almost madly attached to his everyday life, and his antagonist Aya Otonashi, who suddenly transfers into his class—for the 13,118th time. She majestically announces to “break” him, without paying heed to anyone else around them.
This is but the start of a dark roller coaster ride that turns the two against themselves, the people around them and the one who may be god. Read on as their relationship slowly changes as they go against their most basic values in their struggle against the world itself.
villains-transmigration-breaking-every-h:
[WARNING: EXTREMELY MATURE CONTENT AHEAD. READ AT YOUR OWN RISK.]
***
After three years of writing a novel without success, with just a single reader, Alex decided to end his novel forcibly. But the moment he released his last chapter, the scene before him shifted from a dark, gloomy room to a vibrant one filled with decorations.
Before he could do anything, he was faced with the truth that he had been transmigrated into the very novel he had just finished, not as the protagonist, nor as an extra, but as the most hated villain of his novel... Noah Von Asthor. The notorious troublemaking son of the Duchess.
Now he not only has to figure out how to survive as the villain who is hated by all, but he also has to change the end he made if he does not wish to perish by his own hands (and also make a harem, that's a must.)
***
The mc here is a true villain, don't expect him to be just a guy pretending to be one, he is evil to the core, and will literally break the heroines, as well as other villainess or anyone he likes, both physically and mentally until they are obsessed with him, no matter which path he has to take. And yes, he Will love them all as well.…
whats-wrong-with-my-disciples:
[Warning: This story is set in a reverse-world where women dominate society. It contains mature situations that may not be suitable for younger readers.]
Raeshan was an ordinary college student from Earth, until an unexpected death sent him to a world of cultivation.
But this wasn't the cultivation world he knew from novels.
Here, the natural order was reversed.
Women stood at the peak of power, ruling sects, kingdoms, and empires. They possessed overwhelming talent in cultivation, while men were born physically and spiritually weaker, destined to live in their shadows.
Just as Raeshan struggled to adapt to this strange new world, a mysterious voice echoed in his mind.
[Ding...]
[Disciple Master System Activated.]
[New Mission: Recruit your first disciple to unlock additional system functions.]
Forced onto the path of becoming a master, Raeshan begins searching for disciples.
There's just one problem.
Every disciple he accepts is an unparalleled female genius... and instead of treating him as their respected master, they gradually begin developing feelings for him.
“I only wanted to teach them...…
